faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Anganwadi Worker position is 24th August 2026. Ensure you complete all steps before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Anganwadi Worker position in the Women and Child Development Department Odisha recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment must be submitted through the online mode only. No other application methods will be accepted.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for the Anganwadi Worker posts in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all the detailed information.

faq.answer: The Anganwadi Worker positions are offered on a contractual basis, meaning the employment is for a fixed term as per the department's requirements.

faq.answer: The advertisement number for the WCD Odisha Anganwadi Worker recruitment is 1-07.08.26. Please refer to this number for any specific queries.

faq.question: Q8. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Women and Child Development Department Odisha (WCD Odisha).

faq.answer: The recruitment is for eligible candidates in Odisha. Specific eligibility criteria regarding residency may be detailed in the official notification.
